title: Moment.js, read like a tree

specimen.common: Moment.js, the JavaScript date library, cut at HEAD
specimen.note: Six years of thick, steady rings, then the trunk thins. After 2.30 in late 2023 come ten quarters with a single commit between them, the longest pale band in the gallery, and in 2026 the tree puts on a new ring for 2.31.

epilogue: Sixty-four quarterly rings and 706 authors. The built bundles in min/ are left out (extract --exclude min/), so ring colour and shape follow the source, tests and locales rather than the release builds.
